guia.subtitulo: How to use Ashbis, step by step

notificaciones.bloqueadas: You blocked them from your browser/system. To turn them back on, change Ashbis's notification permission in your device settings.
notificaciones.iosAviso: On iPhone/iPad, notifications only work if you add Ashbis to your home screen:
notificaciones.iosPaso1: Tap the Share button ⬆️ in the Safari toolbar.
notificaciones.iosPaso3: Open Ashbis from the icon that was created (not from Safari) and turn the toggle back on here.
notificaciones.noSoportado: Your browser doesn't support push notifications (or the site isn't installed as an app on your home screen).

permisos.subtitulo: We can't change your browser/system permission directly — but you can tell Ashbis not to use the camera or your location even if the permission is still granted.
permisos.camara: Use the camera in the app
permisos.ubicacion: Use my location in the app
permisos.notaNotificaciones: Notifications are turned on from the "Notifications" card above.

cuenta.cuentaGoogle: You sign in with Google — you manage your password from your Google account.

equipos.nota: To see the shelter's work (pets, posts, finances), use the "Shelter" tab in the menu.

mascotas.nota: Each pet's "lost" status (and which contact details show on its public QR) is controlled from that pet's profile.

home.lugaresDescripcion: Tap a button to search for nearby places.
home.mapaFijo: The map stays fixed so it doesn't move on its own when scrolling.
